title: Emergency fund money for March 2026 storm damage
summary: As of October 20, an administration official said no more emergency fund requests are expected for now. In June, officials said they expect to return in fiscal 27 with a budget amendment to cover the funding need. In April, the committee cut the emergency fund by $32 million already authorized for the storms, leaving $85,851,900, and a bill raising the storm amount from $12 million to $32 million was set for second reading May 1st.
